# Pull Request Template

This directory contains the pull request template for the TopoGPT3 repository.

## Template

- **Pull request template** ([pull_request_template.md](pull_request_template.md)): Standard format for submitting code changes.

## Purpose

The pull request template ensures that every submission includes:

- A clear description of what changed and why.
- Verification steps or test results.
- A checklist for code quality and documentation updates.

## Usage

When you open a pull request on GitHub, the template will be pre-filled in the description box. Please complete all sections before submitting.

## Tips

- Keep the scope focused; prefer multiple small PRs over one large PR.
- Reference related issues using `Fixes #issue-number` or `Closes #issue-number`.
- Ensure CI checks pass before requesting review.
